claims.text: The deterministic W110 receipt binds the completed W90 conformance, W100 composition, W105 clean-install journeys, and W110 quality evidence for its exact recorded revisions.
The Application Bridge remains a local validated frame boundary.
The Editor retains the closed MF2 subset, XLIFF text, and review-sidecar interchange boundary.
The hosted product retains D008 opaque-cookie SSR and hydration locale behavior without changing host topology.
Support collection is opt-in, local, bounded, and excludes source, translation, review, session, cookie, and token content.
Offline guidance can only describe a user-performed verified manual replacement; it does not update, download, install, or roll back.
Interrupted Editor transactions require explicit complete or rollback recovery before mutation; stale Bridge state remains rejected.

The retained W110 certification covers linux-x64, win-x64, osx-x64, and osx-arm64 at exact recorded revisions; it does not claim a performance SLA, native assistive-technology certification, or unlisted platforms.
